def summarize_full_modes(table, groups):
    table = np.asarray(table, dtype=complex)
    frequencies = table[0]
    displacements = table[1:]
    norms = np.linalg.norm(displacements, axis=0)
    normalized = displacements / norms
    pieces = [frequencies.real.astype(float), frequencies.imag.astype(float), norms]
    for group in groups:
        block = normalized[:, group]
        projector = block @ block.conj().T
        pieces.extend((projector.real.ravel(), projector.imag.ravel()))
    return np.concatenate(pieces)

assert np.allclose(summarize_full_modes(solve_full_mbc_eigenproblem(K, G), groups), target)

def summarize_matched_modes(table):
    table = np.asarray(table, dtype=complex)
    frequencies = table[0]
    weights = table[1]
    displacements = table[2:]
    norms = np.linalg.norm(displacements, axis=0)
    normalized = displacements / norms
    pieces = [frequencies.real.astype(float), frequencies.imag.astype(float), weights.real.astype(float), weights.imag.astype(float), norms]
    for column in range(normalized.shape[1]):
        projector = np.outer(normalized[:, column], normalized[:, column].conj())
        pieces.extend((projector.real.ravel(), projector.imag.ravel()))
    return np.concatenate(pieces)
